Citizen Alerts
Sign up to receive announcements of important information (e.g., warnings of natural disasters) sent to you through email or text message.
Extension Services
View contact information, access nutrition education materials and find volunteer opportunities.
Health & Human Services
Koochiching County Community Services is directed by law to protect vulnerable adults and children, to help the elderly and disabled, and to assist those citizens whose personal or family resources are not adequate to meet their basic human needs.
Law Enforcement Center
Review the Koochiching County Sheriff's Office mission statement, find law enforcement contact information and access related documents.
Passports
The Koochiching County Recorder’s office is a Passport Agent for the U.S. Department of State Passport Services.
Pay Court Fee / Ticket Online
Pay your court fee or ticket online.
Recycling
Find recycling curbside collection, recycling drop-off locations and accepted recyclables.
Solid Waste Management
Find out how to get coupons to dispose of certain items and view fees for disposing of some items.
Tax Information Request
Learn how to get various types of tax information.
Vital Records Access
Find more information about services provided by the county recorder, such as marriage licenses, birth certificates, death certificates, etc., and view staff contact information.
